hero.title: Community Center
hero.body: Redeveloping a 5,000 sq ft former shipping company into an innovation hub for the 21229 — with a co-op grocery, multimedia center, and retail vending stalls.
hero.alt: 3932 Frederick Avenue with community marketplace mural

sections.title: An innovation hub owned by the neighborhood.
sections.body: The Cooperative is redeveloping 3932-3934 Frederick Ave into the Community Center for Change: a 5,000-square-foot business-incubator hub where minority-owned businesses are welcomed. The space is envisioned as a community-owned co-op grocery, multimedia center, and retail vending stalls. CCD is finalizing plans with ReGEN Consulting and the Neighborhood Design Center.
